title: Version 1.71.0
body:
Version 1.71.0 (The Christmas Update!)

December 1st, 2024

Added:

  • The limited time Christmas update has made it's way to Oaklands, introducing 3 gifts that will be introduced every Saturday! You can find all of the special limited time item store content at Santa's Workshop.
  • Everything that is limited will be using a new currency, Snowflakes! You can earn snowflakes from the new Candycane trees, snowballs, or by talking to Santa Claus for a quest!
  • All of this content will officially disappear on December 30th, this countdown can be found in the Advent Calendar UI. Speaking of such...
  • Every day, you will be able to claim a reward from the Advent Calendar. You have to play on that day to claim it, so don't miss it! Playing for 15 minutes will allow you to claim your beloved item!
  • A new permanent snow biome has been added to Oaklands! This is an extensive biome, with many awesome points of interest, new materials, forageables, and more!
  • A cablecar is the easiest way to navigate across the new snow region, but it comes at a cost: money! Is that worth the risk to you?
  • A new golem store has been added with many awesome items, it's quite cold down there!
  • 🟦🟩🟪 . ... 🟩🟪 . ... ..... 🟦🟦🟩🟪🟩 ....... 🟪 .... 🟪🟩 ..
  • A monument, the Observatory, is here! Many hidden areas as well as restricted sections can be found at the Observatory. There's also two very friendly robotic NPCs!

Changed:

  • You may notice that the Acidlands have disappeared... this is intentional! We are working on revamping this area, which will be released in a later update. We are experimenting with some tech that is going to be pretty awesome, stay tuned for that.

Notes:

  • Thank you for checking out this awesome Oakmas update! There's so much to discover, and so many secrets....."

Version 1.71.1

December 3rd, 2024

Changed:

  • Trees, Rocks, and Scenery now will only generate if you are within the region
  • The Cablecar will now show if you don't have a ticket
  • Cablecar operators will warn you if you do not have enough money to buy a ticket
  • The Cablecar will now refund your ticket if the cablecar fails
  • The Observatory Card now equips in your pocket rather than your waist

Fixed:

  • Fixed the RC Sellner not working on console
  • Fixed the Meteor Telescope not working on console
  • Fixed the Weather Radar not working on console

Version 1.71.2

December 3rd, 2024

Changed:

  • More memory improvements for trees

Version 1.71.3

December 4th, 2024

Changed:

  • Vehicles can now flip regardless of orientation, as long as they are not moving
  • RC Sellners can now have colors, including rare color variants, and the very very rare neon variant

Fixed:

  • Fixed the RC Sellner not being able to flip, use headlights, or honk
  • Fixed a few errors
  • The Tree, Rock, and Scenery region loading should now be fixed in all servers.
  • RC Sellners not saving colors in backwards versions should be fixed.

Version 1.71.4

December 4th, 2024

Changed:

  • The stat tool now works on the RC Sellner

Fixed:

  • Fixed some for the new fruits & plants not having translation strings, as well as them being anchored on rejoin
  • Fixed the Red Keycard having issues with giving free cablecar rides

Version 1.71.5

December 12th, 2024

Changes:

  • Materials outputted from storage drawers can no longer be processed until 15 seconds have passed
  • Chopped and sawed materials can no longer be put into storage drawers until 15 seconds have passed

Fixed:

  • Fixed being able to fly with a Grabbiest Grabber on some characters

Version 1.71.6

December 12th, 2024

Changes:

  • Materials outputted from storage drawers can no longer be processed until 3 seconds have passed
  • Chopped and sawed materials can no longer be put into storage drawers until 3 seconds have passed
  • Lowered the value of Sequoia trees by 2x

Version 1.71.7

December 12th, 2024

  • Removed cooldowns
  • Materials can no longer be sold unless they were interacted with prior to being sold (basically, has to be dragged or brought to the sell area with a car)
  • Changed Sequoia milled value to $7/stud
